paragraphs.source_en:
Any thing that prevents me from thinking does me good. Reading does not occupy
me enough: the only relief I find springs from the composition of poetry, which neces-
sitates contemplations that lift me above the stormy mist of sensations which are my
habitual place of abode. I have lately been composing a poem on Keats. (L ii 296)
